issue: Case: a review run reuses a finding id for a different finding in a later iteration (the code treats ids as unique only per source, so deriveReviewFindingEvidence places the later one at finding:<id>#<iteration>), and the leaf also emits that finding as a graph node/edge ({id:'F1',kind:'FINDING'} plus a RESOLVES edge to 'F1'). knownFindings is filled from every stored FINDING first (386-392) and the current iteration's derived nodes only fill keys still absent (393-397), so resolveReviewFindingId folds the raw id onto the earliest stored node.
